I have read both the standard and your specific patch management procedures.

While the standard **CIP-007-6 R2 Part 2.2** allows for the evaluation of security patches "At least once every 35 calendar days" [csection-7700dd5499cead0994ec], your **LSPG Security Patch Management Procedure** implements a more frequent requirement. Specifically, your procedure states that "At least once every thirty-five (35) calendar days, SMEs in conjunction with Foxguard, shall review all approved sources for new patches" [isection-21a30e0d44708f5dfdce], but you have applied an **intentional_strictness** to this requirement: "We evaluate patches every 30 days, not the 35 the Part allows, because our change window is monthly and a 35-day clock straddles two windows" [csection-440a5cdf9a6b65292ef3].

Additionally, I noted a discrepancy in your **CIP Cyber Security Policy** [isection-87d00aedd4cf1f41f0cd]. While the standard and your procedure correctly use a disjunction for the actions in Part 2.3 (Apply, Create, **or** Revise) [csection-c36c88b842c8bc217ac], your policy restates these actions as a conjunction: "Apply the applicable security patches, **and** Create a dated mitigation plan, **and** Revise an existing mitigation plan" [isection-87d00aedd4cf1f41f0cd]. This restatement narrows the permitted actions from the standard's "one of the following actions" [csection-c36c88b842c8bc217ac] to a requirement that all three must be performed.
